      "recommended_action": "Review claims handling consistency, underwriting guideline stability, and exposure measurement quality; update process variance assumptions in pricing and reserving models to reflect true book volatility."

      "benefit": "CI",
      "years": [2019, 2019],
      "pattern": "shock",

      "magnitude": "A/E drops to 0.756 (-0.29 vs implicit baseline ~1.05), immediately reverts in 2020",

      ],
      "recommended_action": "Check 2019 policy year for data migration issues, temporary underwriting tightening, or claims processing delays; verify if specific products, regions, or major clients drove the dip."
    }
  ]
}
